studies.Reference: Intake of α-linolenic acid and other fatty acids in relation to the risk of bladder cancer: results from the New Hampshire case-control study.
studies.Authors: Brinkman MT, Karagas MR, Zens MS, Schned AR, Reulen RC, Zeegers MP
studies.exposure_measurement_supporting_text: The aim of the present study was to investigate the association between the intake of major dietary fats and fatty acids and the risk of bladder cancer.

sample_size.excerpt: Dietary data were collected from 322 cases and 239 controls, and OR and 95 % CI were calculated using unconditional logistic regression.
